figurative_meaning_en: a very thin or emaciated person
example_sentences_in_bangla: গরিবের কণ্ঠে ত্রিবলি পড়ে গেছে, খুব রোগা হয়ে গেছে।
সে এত ত্রিবলি যে তার গলায় তিনটি রেখা দেখা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: The poor man has become so thin that three lines are visible on his throat.
She is skin and bones, looking extremely emaciated.
note: Refers to visible creases on the neck or abdomen due to extreme thinness, often observed in rural or undernourished contexts.
